prose.subject: Invoice INV-21333 and Updated Payout Account Details
prose.body:
Hi Ines,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to share our latest invoice, INV-21333, for the recent printing services provided to Greywater Robotics. The total amount due is 1452.71 USDC. Please find the invoice document attached for your review and records.

Additionally, I wanted to inform you that we have recently updated our treasury setup. We have added a new payout account, oakhurstprint22-treasury.testnet, which is now linked to our domain, oakhurst-print.example. This change is part of our internal financial restructuring to improve processing efficiency. For this payment, please use the new account mentioned above.

As always, we appreciate your prompt attention to this matter. If you have any questions regarding the invoice or the new account details, please do not hesitate to reach out. I have included our standard bank reference details in the attachment for your convenience.

Thank you for your continued partnership.

Best regards,

Priya Ferro
Accounts Receivable Manager
Oakhurst Print
